notes: Same image and steps as agentmemory-bm25, with the single setting EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local (on-device Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, downloaded at first embedding; status: 'Embeddings: local (384 dims)', 'Provider: noop'). 'agentmemory import-jsonl' reported 'import timed out after 2 minutes' (its own client timeout) and the worker reconnected to the engine once, but the server kept importing and reached 32 sessions, 709 observations about 19 minutes after start on the loaded host; index_seconds is that wall time, an upper bound. Network on for startup and import, then the container was disconnected before the queries. The first query after disconnecting exceeded the runner's 120 s limit (cold model load); the whole set was then run again and that second run is recorded (133 of 134 rankings identical to the first run). Queries: POST /agentmemory/search with only {query}. index_bytes is /data/state_store.db only.
